mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 68 degrees.

October is Community Planning Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz is highlighting the essential role our planning department plays in navigating the city's future and development. Additionally, remember to keep an eye out for potential letters regarding mandatory cross connection control surveys to help maintain our water supply safety.

There is plenty to do around town. Today you can check out the Farley Center Fall Festival or the World Dairy Expo. Tomorrow, head over to Insight Wellness for a yoga session. Looking ahead to October 6, be sure to join the fun for trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee.

In our weekly police report, on September 19, a 10-year-old child was reported missing from Lincoln Street, but thanks to the quick response of police and fire personnel, the child was safely located and reunited with their family.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The restaurant is currently open, so head over before they close at 10:00 PM to enjoy a scoop of this local favorite.
